'Razakar leader' held in Bagerhat
2014-07-22T00:00:00+06:00 | Staff Correspondent
https://www.thedailystar.net/razakar-leader-held-in-bagerhat-34380

A war crimes suspect, believed to be the deputy commander of Bagerhat Razakar Bahini, has been arrested in connection with crimes committed against humanity during the Liberation War, 1971. Police said they arrested Sirajul Islam alias Siraj Master at Dema union in Bagerhat around 11:00pm yesterday. He was allegedly a close aide to AKM Yusuf, Jamaat leader and founder of notorious auxiliary force Razakar Bahini in 1971. Syed Sayedul Haque Sumon, a prosecutor, told The Daily Star that the International Crimes Tribunal-1 issued the arrest warrants against three war crimes suspects, including Siraj, on June 10. Police already had arrested the other two.
